main_measure.name: 24-bar forward return, top-decile forecast minus zero-forecast bars (%)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: positive with t >= 2; reject: negative with t <= -2, or |t| < 2 with >= 150 cases and |estimate| <= 0.1% per 24 bars

supporting_check.name: coins with return per unit avg exposure minus buy-and-hold > 0 (need >= 2)

decided_by: |t| < 2 but the estimate lies outside the +/-0.1% near-zero bound, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: The top decile is forecast >= the 90th percentile of all pooled bars' forecasts (and > 0), returns are sampled on the 0,24,48,... grid of each window with Welch t, the supporting check sums per-bar gains and per-bar coin returns over each coin's pooled windows with exposure as mean |allocation|, and with only 2 coins present 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' is applied literally as at least 2 coins.
